title: Place and configure map sounds
summary: Assign sound aliases to placed markers and control preview and game playback.
outcome: Sound emitters with intentional timing and range.

steps.title: Load the sound library
steps.text: Open the Sounds browser and choose the raw library. Search assets and use Preview to audition an available alias.

steps.title: Assign to a marker
steps.text: Drag an alias from the Sounds browser into a viewport to place a sound marker. To change an existing marker, select it and choose Set Selected Sound; in the Entities inspector, confirm the reference and Apply reference.

sections.title: Set game behavior

steps.title: Configure playback
steps.text: Choose Loop or Play once at map start, then adjust Volume, Pitch, inner and outer hearing ranges, and Channel as needed. Choose Apply sound settings.

steps.title: Review preview
steps.text: Enable Sounds above the camera to hear placed emitters; use Reset to discard sound overrides when defaults are preferable.

tips: Use the same raw library for sounds and the PS3 fastfile build. An unavailable preview may reflect a missing source alias or unsupported preview asset.
